connector.name: MCP Gateway by rupinder2
connector.registryDescription: Aggregates tools from multiple MCP servers with unified BM25/regex search and deferred loading.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-orchestration-gateway. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rupinder2 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: STORAGE_BACKEND
env.description: Storage backend for tool cache. Use 'memory' for development or 'redis' for production.

env.name: REDIS_URL
env.description: Redis connection URL. Required only when STORAGE_BACKEND=redis.

env.name: SERVER_CONFIG_PATH
env.description: Path to the server_config.json file listing downstream MCP servers.
